limits: Same source-read tasks; no population-zero or holdout claim.
Only controller fact packet and repair suffix varied; this does not identify every historical revision effect.
Derived information removal is not a pure representation contrast.
Descriptive task bootstrap does not cover model drift or development selection.
Common initial state and clock do not eliminate native participant set-order variation. Exact-request coupling does not merge distinct histories; localization preserves every primary outcome.
Actual network cost is shared by experimental arms; missing usage remains unknown.
